attributes.board_name: Delaware Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline

rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA Category I courses or equivalent AOA-approved courses; approved residency/fellowship participation in lieu of CME; certification by the Medical Society of Delaware accepted as proof
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: licensed under 1 year - no CME; 1 to 2 years - 20 hours.
rules.audit_note: CE entered in the DELPROS CE Tracker; random audits - upload certificates only when selected.

topics.who: All licensees, before every renewal: recognizing child sexual and physical abuse, exploitation and domestic violence, and reporting obligations (Office of the Child Advocate course)
Covered by the same 1-hour mandatory reporting training
Holders of a Delaware Controlled Substance registration: controlled substance prescribing, chronic pain treatment or related topics; the same hours from the practitioner license count

rules.notes: One board for MDs and DOs. Licenses expire March 31 of odd-numbered years; CME period April 1 - March 31. Late renewal up to one year with 50% late fee.
rules.legal_basis: Board Rules and Regulations Section 12.0 (24 Del. Admin. Code 1700); 24 Del. C. §1723
